title: Doximity: The Hub of Healthcare - [Business Breakdowns, EP.236]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we are breaking down one of the more impressive B2B media businesses I have come across, Doximity.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down one of the more impressive B2B media businesses I have come across, Doximity. It's been called “the LinkedIn for doctors.” Jim Jones, partner and analyst at William Blair Asset Management, helped explain exactly how Doximity works as a business. Jim gets into the community engine that works for and around medical professionals.

key_points.text: And yes, there is a social network, but it's the add-ons, such as the required continued education that doctors can complete on the platform.
The revenue engine is advertising, and Jim delves into the nuances of how that spend works.
Please enjoy this Breakdown of Doximity.
